decisions.reason: 삭신이야 is body-aches; “aches” is the right collocation for bones.
물들어 is stained all over; SOL adds bruises and drops 온통.
꼬장꼬장하게 생긴 is crotchety-looking, not quarrelsome cantankerous.
겁에 질린 is terrified, not trembling; “as thick as stakes” naturalizes 말뚝 같은.
Keeps the question in the merged H004 sentence instead of a duplicate line.
가급적 조금만 놔 주세요 is a spoken “go easy on me,” not the calque “if possible.”
그러지 뭐 is casual acquiescence; “Sure” alone flattens the 뭐.
시원시원하게 is brisk and unhesitating, not cheerful.
이제야 is the “finally” punchline after he is silenced.
“Having silenced” is stiffer than “After silencing”; the needle reorder does not outweigh that.
목청 is voice, not lungs; “hale and hearty” keeps the 팔팔 idiom.
decisions.replacement: “A young punk like you, making such a fuss. From the sound of that voice, you’ll be hale and hearty for another fifty years.”

decisions.reason: 되어 버린 is became a porcupine, not porcupine-like; “turned to me” drops the 고개 calque.
decisions.replacement: Leaving Hyuk Mujin, who had turned into a porcupine, behind, the Medicine King Hall Master turned to me.

decisions.reason: 까 봐 is a blunt one-word strip command.
뭐, 뭘요 repeats “what,” not a W- stutter.
Keeps 나발이고 and 곁눈질; “entered the equation” is essay-like and “eyed” loses the sidelong glance.
뭐 하는 놈이야 is “what the hell are you,” not “what are you made of.”
“Understandably so” is more natural, but 몸/깨끗 is a clean body, not completely clear skin.
decisions.replacement: His voice was full of astonishment, and understandably so. Until yesterday, my body had been covered in bruises, but now it was clean.

decisions.reason: No comma before “either” in this sentence.
하룻밤 and 멀쩡해졌다 as a single night’s sleep / perfectly fine.
Keep 것 같다 and 신기한; 잔뼈가 굵은 is seasoned, not a so…that causal.
decisions.replacement: It seemed that simply sleeping now let me recover quickly from most ordinary bruises. Even the Medicine King Hall Master, a physician seasoned by years of experience, found me fascinating and examined me for quite some time.

decisions.reason: 간밤 is last night, not “during the night.”
푹 잤는데요 is a casual “good night’s sleep.”
SOL drops 효능.
“As if” and “as though” are indistinguishable here.
반색했다 has no “immediately.”
쑤셔 버릴 is a violent ram, not a mild jab.
쑤셔 대는데 is ongoing jabbing, not a single stab.
“That’ll be” is the tighter deadpan thought.
침 맞기 싫으면 is “unless you want the needles too,” with Mujin already needled.
고맙다 is terse Thanks, not Thank you.
Keeps 순간이었다; SOL adds unsupported eagerness.
한 줄기 깨달음 is a mock-grand flash of insight; “realization” flattens the joke.
“Leaving me with nowhere” is cleaner; standing is already established from rising.
설마 하며 is wondering if it could really be him, not expecting the impossible.
“A beat too late” is the natural delayed-reaction idiom.
Keeps 아니; SOL adds “happened to stop by.”
“Hearing about my situation” is the natural English collocation.
거처 under his solemn act is a residence, not a casual “somewhere to stay.”
의식한 is conscious of watchers; 냉철 is coolheaded, not cold.
소가주님이시다 is a declarative spotting line, not an added exclamation.
잖아 is “you know how.”
동생 바보 is a fool for his brother; SOL’s “sucker” and added “the truth” drift.
비정상 is abnormal, not the weaker “strange.”
Captures 오죽했을까, 직후, and 기쁨을 못 이겨.
그 난리 is “such a spectacle”; SOL is a weaker synonym.
No comma before “too” in this short sound-transmission line.
노려 볼 만하다 is “had a shot at”; the split thought reads more naturally.
몸은 괜찮으냐 is physical all right, not “feeling”; 이해했으면 does not require “him.”
decisions.replacement: —Are you all right? Mukyung didn’t do it out of malice, so I hope you’ll understand.

decisions.reason: Keep 흘러넘치다; SOL’s “plenty” weakens it, and “next” is extra.
decisions.replacement: His fists had been overflowing with malice. It was only thanks to my rapid recovery that I hadn’t spent several days staring at the Medicine King Hall ceiling.

decisions.reason: 어린놈이 성질도 더러운데 is that kid’s nasty temper, not a neutral “he was young, ill-tempered.”
Fronting “the moment he appeared” is more natural English for 등장과 동시에.
“Oblivious to my thoughts” naturalizes 속마음도 모르는 without the calque.
중심부 as “heart” is the natural English for a bustling core.
Keep the 성세/size opening; 둘러볼 수 없는 is inability, not “never explored,” and 발 닿는 stays.
decisions.replacement: The sheer size of the Jin Family of Taiyuan’s estate spoke to its former glory. Even from a distance, it looked as large as several soccer fields combined, so it was only natural that I couldn’t see everything. There were still unfamiliar places everywhere my feet took me.

decisions.reason: 이제 and 인적이 뚝 끊겨 / 텅 비었다 as “by now” and a deserted road.
The 것 같은 atmosphere joke reads as what rats and ghosts do there, not a hedged “could.”
지금까지 … 벅차서 is present perfect “has been,” not “was.”
상관없는데 is “I don’t really mind.”
버티다 is lasted, not survived; 잡으면 is catch.
decisions.replacement: I had lasted five whole years in a cramped, three-pyeong goshiwon studio.[^2] Rats could be caught, and as for ghosts… Well, it wasn’t as if real ghosts would actually show up.

decisions.reason: 넓기만 하면, 뭐 continues 상관없다 as “I don’t mind.”
어떤 경우건 간에 is “no matter the circumstances,” the ominous setup SOL flattens.
전제 is premise, not phrasing.
싫다고 할까 봐 is dislike, not the milder “not like.”
“Possessed” is stiffer than “had” for 멋이 풍겼다.
“No reason at all” and “absolutely no reason” are indistinguishable for 전혀 없다.
흐뭇한 듯 is looking pleased, not “clearly.”
깔끔하고 / 일단 넓어 is two beats; merging them loses the 일단 lift.
오. is still short of the later 오오; the exclamation front-loads it.
“Between you” names two occupants too early; 나눠서 쓰면 is still vague.
Keeps “divide them up” with the previous line; dropping “up” is mere churn.
아니었어요 is the mistaken assumption he would use it alone.
“Gave an awkward smile” and “smiled awkwardly” are indistinguishable for 어색하게 웃었다.
둘이 써도 is two people using it; SOL drops 써도 and adds “even.”
누군데요 is “Who is it?” not a clipped “Who?”
“Began to creep” and “began creeping” are indistinguishable for 스멀스멀 올라온다.
나쁜 직감은 항상 is a generic maxim, not this one premonition.
The rebuilt 처소 is Taekyung’s; BASE’s “your” addresses Mukyung wrongly.
그렇게 하시죠 is Mukyung’s formal “Very well,” not casual “Let’s do that.”
Keeps 예상치 못한 and 나는 물론이고 before Wikyung.
“Send me one person” makes the implied recipient explicit in natural English.
들일까 is bring in, not hire.
필요 없습니다 is formal “unnecessary,” matching Mukyung’s register.
그윽한 눈빛 here is a long, meaningful look, not a body-part “deep, intent eyes.”
불러 주십시오 is a polite request; dropping “Please” flattens Mukyung.
거리 is singular; 비명 하나 새어 나가지 is a scream not leaking out.
아주 is the “really” intensifier SOL drops.
Attribution belongs in the following merged speech line.
Needs both 오한 and 떨릴, plus the double 아니지; SOL’s “you don’t mean that” recasts the first.
decisions.replacement: As I shivered with a chill, Jin Wikyung stammered, “M-Mukyung. No, that’s not it, right? It’s not what I’m thinking, right?”

decisions.reason: 불러야겠죠 keeps “call,” paralleling the physician.
지체하지 않고 is without delay, not hesitation; 몸을 날렸다 is threw, not hurled.
“Hauled” and “let out a short laugh” are more natural for the same nape-catch and 피식 웃었다.
지지 않고 is without backing down; SOL drops it and BASE’s “holding anything in” misses it.
decisions.replacement: This time I fired back without backing down.

decisions.reason: 개냐? 적토마지? is two tag questions; SOL’s “That’d be Red Hare” kills the second.
맞고도 is taking that beating, not merely “after that beating.”
지금까지와는 달리 has no “utterly.”
착한 사람 is a kind person; the proverb applies to him without the clunky “looking at… I understood.”
형제끼리 stays in “as brothers”; SOL’s extra “You’re brothers” and “right” add lecture and intensity.
“Mukyung and I both” is more natural than “both Mukyung and I.”
다 지어질 때까지만 / 이었느냐 is just until it is finished, past “was,” not “rebuilt / is that really.”
찔릴 수밖에 없다 is couldn’t help feeling guilty, not “every reason.”
저 녀석 is that brat, not “that guy” or “this brat.”
decisions.replacement: “That was because that brat was being rude…”

decisions.reason: Present rhetorical accusation; 두들겨 패 is beat up.
참았다 is held myself back, in the narrator’s comic voice; “restrained” is stiffer.
이제 is “now.”
대답! is “Answer!” with no added “me.”
준엄한 눈빛 is glared sternly, not “with a stern expression.”
결정이다 is present “this is,” not “was.”
허공에서 is the gazes colliding in midair.
튀어나왔다 is burst out; both candidates flatten it to “came.”
decisions.replacement: Our answers burst out at the same time.

decisions.reason: 싫은데요 has no contrastive “But.”
저도 싫습니다 is Mukyung’s formal register against the MC’s casual refusal.
답정너 is one rhetorical punchline: why ask with the answer already set.
